stem: Which set of physical findings is most typical of trisomy 21 in a newborn?

options.text: Single palmar crease, downslanting palpebral fissures and micrognathia
Tall stature, arachnodactyly and lens dislocation
Single palmar crease, upslanting palpebral fissures and protruding tongue
Macrocephaly, cafe-au-lait spots and axillary freckling
Short limbs, frontal bossing and trident hands
